aiGuidance.extraction: One record per axis; its grades point at it with `grades`.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Agents never edit policy records: propose a change as a comment on the record, with the evidence.
aiGuidance.purpose: An independent dimension of confidence; rules combine axes.

description: One question the Confidence and care policy asks about a work item, such as: is the theory it rests on grounded? Each axis is graded on the confidence_level scale by its grades.
name: confidence-axis
